standard_prerequisites.use: D_+(T_i) cover Proj(S) because the T_i generate S_+.

core_obligations: S_+ = (T_0, ..., T_n), so the n+1 standard opens D_+(T_i) cover P^n_Z.
Each chart ring is Z[T_0/T_i, ..., T_n/T_i], so D_+(T_i) is Spec of a polynomial ring, visibly A^n_Z.
proof_roadmap: Check the irrelevant ideal, then display the chart identification with affine space.
difficulty_reason: Two displayed identities: the irrelevant ideal is generated by the coordinates, and each chart ring is a polynomial ring; fully displayed.
